clue.text: You row about clothes line

parts.note: a row is an argument, which is an exchange of cross words

indicators.note: to clothe is to wrap around, so one piece wears the other inside it

parts.note: over can mean about, as in arguing over something

explanation.surface: Someone is told they are rowing a boat around a washing line.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the reader: this clue addresses you, the person solving it. A row is a quarrel, words spoken in anger.
explanation.definitionFit: The person reading this clue is, at that moment, the puzzle solver being addressed.

clue.text: Flibbertigibbet after antelope in Africa

parts.note: a flibbertigibbet is a flighty, mischievous person, an imp
a la means in the style of, after the manner of

explanation.surface: A scatterbrained person chases an antelope across Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: The impala is a medium-sized antelope found across eastern and southern Africa.

clue.text: Obsessive about getting out of the groove

indicators.note: the letter for about is leaving the groove word, so it is removed

parts.note: a canal is a channel or groove, as in anatomy
C stands for circa, Latin for about

explanation.surface: Someone obsessive is trying to escape from a rut.
explanation.definitionFit: Anal in the informal, psychological sense describes someone fussy and fixated on detail.

clue.text: Abraham's due date for treatment with morphine and LSD

indicators.note: the three words are put through treatment, being worked over into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A patient is booked in for a date to be treated with strong drugs.
explanation.walkthrough: In Genesis God promises Canaan to Abraham and his descendants, so it is what is due to him.
explanation.definitionFit: Canaan was the land God pledged to Abraham's descendants, so it was his promised inheritance.

clue.text: Tra-la-la tune frightfully posh? No

indicators.note: frightfully suggests the letters are thrown into disarray
No says the posh letter is absent from the jumbled tune

parts.note: U is the label for upper-class, posh usage

explanation.surface: Someone dismisses a cheerful melody as not frightfully upper-class.
explanation.walkthrough: Rearrange TRALALATUNE without U. The whole clue also describes the answer: a lively folk tune, not a posh one.
explanation.definitionFit: A tarantella is a rapid, whirling Italian folk dance and its music, hardly an aristocratic piece.

clue.text: Aston Villa executive initially welcoming supporters close to Unai Emery?

indicators.note: welcoming means the initials take the other letters in
initially picks the opening letter of each of the three words

parts.note: bras are supporting garments

indicators.note: close to here means the end letter of Unai

explanation.surface: Aston Villa's boss Unai Emery is described as a rough customer to his executives.
explanation.walkthrough: Unai Emery managed Aston Villa; the definition takes his surname as the gritty powder.
explanation.definitionFit: Emery is a granular rock used as an abrasive, for instance on emery boards for nails.

clue.text: Labourer turns avant-garde, supporting Baroque music functions

indicators.note: in a down answer, supporting puts the following pieces beneath the composer

parts.note: Bach is the archetypal Baroque composer, standing for his music

indicators.note: turns tells us to read the labourer word backwards

parts.note: a prole is a working person, a labourer
arties are arty, avant-garde types

explanation.surface: A worker becomes experimental and takes up Baroque music.
explanation.definitionFit: Stag nights are social events, and a function is a formal or social gathering.

clue.text: Wild fourth item in mythical narration, maybe

definitions.text: Wild fourth item in mythical narration, maybe

indicators.note: wild here means the letters run riot into a new order
fourth item in picks the letter in fourth position of mythical

explanation.surface: A storyteller reaches the fourth episode of a myth, perhaps a savage one.
explanation.walkthrough: Capturing the wild boar of Mount Erymanthus was the fourth of the twelve labours of Heracles, so the whole clue is also the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: This savage beast was the subject of Hercules' fourth labour in Greek legend.

clue.text: Contrary attitude, retaining bell edge with shells

indicators.note: retaining means holding the other piece inside
contrary means turned the opposite way, so read the word backwards

parts.note: a pose is an attitude struck
to give someone a bell is to phone them, a call

explanation.surface: A stubborn stance keeps a bell's rim ringed with seashells.
explanation.definitionFit: To escallop is to decorate a border with scalloped, shell-like curves, a variant of scallop.

clue.text: Brave husband divorces without delay

indicators.note: divorces means splitting apart, so the husband letter separates the other word

parts.note: apace means quickly, without delay

explanation.surface: A man walks out on his marriage instantly.
explanation.walkthrough: Brave is the old term for a Native American warrior, not an adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: An Apache warrior is a brave in the traditional term for a Native American fighting man.

clue.text: Anxiously wait to use toilet? Finally!

definitions.text: Anxiously wait to use toilet? Finally!

indicators.note: anxiously suggests jittery movement, so the letters are shuffled
finally takes the end letter of toilet

explanation.surface: Someone in a long queue for the loo is relieved at last.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is also the definition: waiting anxiously for the toilet is having to endure it.
explanation.definitionFit: To endure a stressful wait until it is over is the idiom for enduring something unpleasant.

clue.text: Name, say, robot aid for broadcast

definitions.text: Name, say, robot aid for broadcast

parts.note: a name is an example of identification, ID

indicators.note: broadcast scatters the letters, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A presenter's mechanical helper is introduced for a programme.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue also defines the answer, a prompt board held up for presenters on air.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiot board is a cue card or teleprompter that helps a television presenter remember lines.

clue.text: He wrote Spamalot while away

definitions.meaning: Eric ... of Monty Python wrote the musical Spamalot
to ... away time is to spend it lazily

explanation.walkthrough: Spamalot is the stage musical based on Monty Python and the Holy Grail.
explanation.definitionFit: Eric Idle is the Python behind the musical, and idling away hours means passing time doing nothing.

clue.text: Dutch courage? It may be needed for serious theatre work

definitions.meaning: Dutch courage is bravery that is not genuine, and courage is heart

definitions.text: It may be needed for serious theatre work
definitions.meaning: an operating theatre may implant such a device in major surgery

explanation.walkthrough: The theatre is the surgeon's operating theatre, not the stage. Dutch courage is bravery from drink, so fake heart.
explanation.definitionFit: A mechanical pump replacing a failing organ is fitted in major cardiac surgery, and drink-fuelled bravery is fake nerve.

clue.text: This person refuses to adopt singer's image

parts.note: this person, the setter speaking, is I

indicators.note: to adopt means to take in, so the bird goes inside

parts.note: to deny is to refuse
a tit is a small songbird

explanation.surface: Someone refuses to take on a vocalist's public persona.
explanation.definitionFit: A brand's image is its public identity, the character it presents to the world.

clue.text: Tortoise — eventually — has got it!

indicators.note: has means holds within, so the word tortoise holds the letters

parts.note: the closing letters of tortoise
E is the letter that eventually begins with, standing in for it

explanation.walkthrough: The loose E for eventually is the setter's liberty; the image of a tortoise slowly catching on fits the exclamation.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying it is the everyday exclamation of someone who has at last understood.

clue.text: Doch-an-doris for Kitty, perhaps, and straight home

definitions.meaning: a doch-an-doris is a parting drink; a cat's final drink would be its last lapping of milk
the home straight of a race is its final circuit

explanation.walkthrough: A doch-an-doris is a Scottish or Irish farewell drink, a one for the road; cats drink by lapping.
explanation.definitionFit: A cat's farewell drink is its final lapping, and the final circuit of a race is the run to the finish.

clue.text: A teenager no longer worked for nothing in play

indicators.note: for means standing in place of, so one piece replaces another

parts.note: a toy is a plaything
O looks like zero, nothing
went means worked, as in a machine that went

explanation.surface: An unpaid stage play by a young actor.
explanation.definitionFit: Turning that age means leaving the teen years, the nineteen and under span.

clue.text: Bloody fortune to Brahms & Liszt

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for bloody, used as a mild curse
one's lot is one's fortune or fate

explanation.surface: A great sum of money is left to two famous composers.
explanation.walkthrough: Brahms and Liszt is Cockney rhyming slang for pissed, meaning drunk.
explanation.definitionFit: Blotto means extremely drunk, which the rhyming slang phrase also means.

clue.text: Textbook Left-handed Potter billiard pockets

indicators.note: left-handed means running leftwards, so the letters are read backwards
pockets means the phrase holds the letters inside it

explanation.surface: A left-handed snooker player pots balls in a billiard game, according to a manual.
explanation.walkthrough: Textbook is read as text plus book: the words of an opera.
explanation.definitionFit: A libretto is the written text of an opera or musical, literally Italian for little book.

clue.text: Pint-sized sailor's boarding times

indicators.note: boarding means getting on or in, so one piece enters the other

parts.note: by means times in multiplication, as in four by six
AB, able-bodied seaman, is a sailor; the 's is sailor is

explanation.surface: A small seaman boards a vessel on several occasions.
explanation.definitionFit: Baby as an adjective means small, as in baby carrots, a miniature version.

clue.text: Pair in the ring of course continually improving

definitions.text: Pair in the ring of course
definitions.meaning: two gamblers in the betting ring at a racecourse

explanation.walkthrough: The ring is the betting area at a racecourse, so the pair are two punters there, not boxers.
explanation.definitionFit: Two gamblers joined together read as a phrase meaning progressively more good over time.
